description: JavaScript source code for Jesse Weisbeck's crossword puzzle plugin using jQuery. It defines a jQuery plugin that creates an interactive crossword puzzle with functions for building the grid, handling user input, navigation, and answer checking.

classes.name: puzInit
classes.description: Object containing methods to initialize and build the crossword puzzle grid, calculate coordinates, check answers, etc.

classes.name: nav
classes.description: Object managing navigation between clues and entries, including updating active positions and moving focus.

classes.name: util
classes.description: Utility functions for highlighting entries and clues, getting classes, managing active positions, and checking solutions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the crossword puzzle, sorts data, sets event handlers, and builds the grid and clues.

methods.name: calcCoords
methods.description: Calculates all coordinates for each entry based on starting positions and orientations, and adds clues to the DOM.

methods.name: buildTable
methods.description: Builds the HTML table grid for the crossword puzzle based on calculated rows and columns.

methods.name: buildEntries
methods.description: Populates the grid with answer entries, adds input fields, and labels for each word.

methods.name: checkAnswer
methods.description: Checks if the current input matches the answer for the active entry and marks it as solved if correct.
